newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices slip on French poll jitters.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices slip on French poll jitters.

text.p: Danish bond prices slipped in early trade on Monday, hit by French election speculation, with dealers seeing French market declines hitting the local market and the 10-year German yield gap widening.

"The French bond market did worse than Germany from the word go today. This combined with renewed EMU fears could probably rub off on us, forcing the yield gap with Germany up to 75 basis points by the close," one dealer said.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 stood 0.42 point lower than Friday's close at 109.18 at 0800 gmt.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 73 basis points. The crown traded at 3.8103 per mark, weakening from Friday's closing 3.8095.
